budget.notes: 15% conv runtime allowance and 30s extra compile are in budget inputs; no stage transfers
budget.timeout_policy: 1.30 * (forecast updates + compilation + final work), rounded up to 100 seconds

policy.candidate_rule: Keep original nominal common-target ceiling steps unchanged.
policy.control_rule: ceil(max over included candidates i and conventions k of candidate_steps_i * work_fpt_i_k / work_fpt_control_k)
policy.limitation: Conservative allowance for four specified arithmetic conventions; not a measurement or guarantee of equal hardware-executed GPU FLOPs.
policy.name: beyond-language-conservative-control-allowance-v1
policy.remat_scope: One extra counted whole-block forward; exclude vocabulary projection and do not duplicate the backward-only chunk solve surcharge.
policy.rounding: Exact rational ratios; smallest whole update count satisfying every declared convention.
policy.scope: Before language quality results; all five controls and every independently confirmed candidate.

source_forward_adjustment.GDN1_DP4: 0; retain already-counted dense chunk work and solve backward surcharge

policy.source_scope: Full dense attention; credit explicitly combined corrected-weight value products; do not credit common-subexpression sharing of A's duplicate ordinary value product.

limitations: Pins the observed token bytes, not the unrecorded original download revision or tokenizer build.
Pre/post size and mtime agreement is checked; this is not an atomic immutable-volume snapshot.
No per-job remote rehash; repeat this fingerprint after the study and compare both file digests.
dataset_evidence.method: local control-plane modal.Volume.read_file streaming SHA-256; no Modal Functions

recipe_evidence.scope: Current preparation source describes the intended recipe; this does not prove the historical preparation invocation.
recipe_evidence.split: Preserve Parquet row order; zero-based document indices divisible by 100 are validation; all others training.
recipe_evidence.tokenizer: tiktoken.get_encoding('gpt2'), encode_ordinary_batch; append EOT 50256 to every document.
recipe_evidence.unknown_reason: Preparation used an unpinned dataset revision and unpinned packages; the volume contains no preparation metadata sidecar.

sampling_recipe.training: numpy.default_rng(run seed); contiguous 513-token windows with replacement produce 512 next-token targets.
sampling_recipe.validation_scope: Both samples draw from val.bin; different window draws, not separate document partitions.

storage.byte_order_evidence: Preparation and reader use native numpy.uint16 on the Linux Modal runtime; no file header.

headline_rule.convP: separate mechanism comparator; no useful composition gain claimed if not improved
headline_rule.requires: all three independent Stage-2 seeds and prior Stage-1 confirmation
headline_rule.significance: observed preregistered gate, not a statistical-significance claim

selection_rule: minimum finite final validation loss; exact ties choose lower rate; all jobs terminal

stage1_gate_reconciliation.adoption_scope: Only confirmations prospectively registered under this sealed reconciliation; no retrospective change to the strict-code outcome.

policy.candidate_requirement: Frozen selected candidate must be ready, COMPLETE, finite, and in [0,1].
policy.change: Remove only the numeric reference-floor veto; retain absolute candidate thresholds, reference gap, and all-six-cells requirement.
policy.disclosure: Prospective code/text reconciliation after seed0 results; original executable outcomes remain reported separately. Fresh confirmation does not retroactively pass the original executable rule.
policy.name: beyond-stage1-written-rule-reconciliation-v1
policy.reference_requirement: Frozen selected reference must be ready, COMPLETE, finite, and in [0,1]; pending/missing/invalid references never pass.
policy.scope: Uniformly all A/B/C candidates and all six registered primary cells.

tuning_failure_policy.allocation_rule: Retain the original plan, survivors, all candidate schedules and control allowances, including allowances for a tuning-invalid candidate.
tuning_failure_policy.candidate_rule: A candidate with no valid trial is tuning_invalid and unconfirmed; every candidate with a valid trial must enter finals.
tuning_failure_policy.control_rule: All five controls rawS, convS, convP, GDN1 and DP4 require a valid selected rate.
tuning_failure_policy.interpretation: Invalid trials are numerical, operational or incomplete measurements; exclusion is not a measured quality loss.
tuning_failure_policy.name: beyond-language-candidate-local-tuning-failure-v1
tuning_failure_policy.stop_rule: Stop the entire final grid if any mandatory control has no valid trial or no candidate has a valid trial.
tuning_failure_policy.terminal_rule: All three registered trials of every original arm must be terminal before any rate selection.
